set: A: the keys `boss-fight` and `boss-down` and the sheet `boss-stages`, whole and in native crops, each beside the approved image

issues.what: the cursor points flat to the right and is a small grey metallic arrow with almost no dark edge; the target is a white glossy arrow with a thick black outline pointing up-left along the shot line
issues.fix: turn it to point up-left toward the machine, make the body white gloss with a heavy black edge and a soft shadow to the lower right

issues.what: the card is opaque flat grey plastic; the target is translucent pale sea-green frosted glass with a bright bevelled edge
issues.fix: make it frosted translucent glass with a cool green-grey tint, the page faintly visible through it, and a lit bevel

issues.where: the shield, left of the machine
issues.what: the shield is a solid mint-green slab in a thick white plastic frame; the target is clear frosted glass with a thin bright edge
issues.fix: make it clear, slightly frosted glass with a thin bright rim and see-through to the page and arm behind

issues.what: the arrow is a small clean grey cursor; the target's arrow is battered: white body, thick black edge, chipped jagged outline, scorch flecks
issues.fix: use the white gloss body with heavy black edge and add the chips, nicks along the edge and scorch spots

issues.where: the Unfolding state, third from left
issues.what: the plate is already the full wide boss plate with long extended legs; in the target it is a compact plate barely larger than the button with short legs just folding out
issues.fix: shrink the plate to hug the button and draw the legs short and bent close to the body

issues.where: all orange parts: Submit button, progress fill, step 4 button
issues.what: the orange is a dull dark brick red-orange with weak highlight; the target is a bright saturated glossy orange with a strong top highlight
issues.fix: lift to a brighter, warmer orange and add a crisp glossy highlight along the top

issues.where: the error tags Required field, Invalid input, Session expired
issues.what: the tags are a muted brick red, matte and flat-topped; the target tags are a deeper glossy crimson with a lit top edge
issues.fix: move to a richer crimson with gloss and a bright bevel on the top edge

issues.where: the front plate and cannons of the machine
issues.what: the metal is light, matte, uniformly grey with rivets; the target is darker polished steel with strong reflections and dark contrast in the hollows
issues.fix: darken the steel, add polished reflections and deeper contrast; make the cannon barrels sit on round domed housings as in the target

issues.what: buttons 1 and 2 are missing from the row (only 3, 4, 5 on a bare rail), and the numbers 1 and 2 appear on the cannon discs instead
issues.fix: if not intended for this pair, restore 1 and 2 to the row with even spacing; at least balance the rail so the left end is not an empty stretch

issues.where: the error tags and the shot line, middle
issues.what: the tags are scattered differently: Session expired sits over the socket, Invalid input low and left, the shot passes below them; the target stacks them in a loose column between the card and the machine with the shot running through the gap
issues.fix: place the tags in a column right of centre, clear of the socket, with the shot running between them

issues.what: the cap is a flat thin plank with flat ends and a dark rusty texture; the target is a plump rounded capsule with domed ends and burnt black blisters
issues.fix: round the cap into a thick capsule with domed ends and make the burns glossy black charred blisters, not a flat rust texture

issues.what: the shard is opaque green with a white plastic frame and white painted crack lines; the target is clear glass with fine bright cracks
issues.fix: make it clear pale glass with thin refractive crack lines and no white frame

issues.where: the scattered side pieces and plates
issues.what: the pieces are light flat grey with rivets and folded edges; the target pieces are darker brushed steel slabs with visible grain and harder shadows
issues.fix: darken them to brushed steel with horizontal grain and a firmer shadow to the lower right

issues.what: the button sits in a black rim; the target sits in a bright polished silver bezel
issues.fix: replace the black rim with a lit chrome bezel

issues.what: the state captions under the four states are missing
issues.fix: set a small dark grey caption centred under each state on one baseline

issues.what: a horizontal seam line runs across the tilted cap through the word
issues.fix: remove the seam so the cap face is one smooth glossy surface

issues.where: the open socket in the rim
issues.what: the inside is a flat smooth black; the target shows a dark rough grey floor with depth and a thicker steel rim
issues.fix: add a rough dark floor with a gradient into depth and thicken the rim slightly

issues.what: an extra two-line grey note sits under the card that the target does not have
issues.fix: remove it or confirm it belongs in this state

issues.what: the smoke rises from the middle of the cap in thin even strands; the target's wisps rise from the burnt ends and curl
issues.fix: start the wisps at the burnt ends and let them curl and fade
